newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Elektrowatt sees expansion under Siemens.
newsitem.headline: Elektrowatt sees expansion under Siemens.

text.p: The core industrial activities of Swiss group Elektrowatt AG are likely to be expanded rather than cut back when German electronics giant Siemens AG takes over, Elektrowatt chief executive Oskar Ronner said in an interview.
Siemens said on Monday it was buying a 44.9 percent stake in Elektrowatt's industrial division from bank group CS Holding and would launch a public offer for remaining shares.

Ronner was quoted by the Swiss news agency SDA as saying he expected "more of an expansion than a reduction" by Siemens at the core industrial businesses -- Landis & Staefa building controls, Cerberus security systems and Landis & Gyr Utilities metres.
"There is no reason to doubt Siemens' statement that it wants to make the three big businesses into a worldwide centre," Ronner told SDA.
Siemens said on Monday it planned to make the three Elektrowatt core areas its global centre for the business of building controls, security systems and current metres.

Roner told SDA there had been no talks with Siemens about plans for the five smaller Elektrowatt divisions -- Kummler+Matter, Vibro-Meter, Goehner Merkur, Landis&Gyr Communications and Electrowatt Engineering. -- Zurich Newsroom, +41-1-631 7340
